_about: A decision boundary for the satellite segment classifier on the overlay's plane (Round 86): the slice through the medoid, the two-feature surrogate, and which one passed. Written by scripts/measure_satellite_boundary.py; aggregate figures only.

slice.anchor: the test partition's medoid in z-space (train mean and SD)
slice.near_rule: every held feature within 1 SD of the medoid's

surrogate.form: logistic regression on n_peaks, diff2_peaks, their squares and product, standardised, fitted to the published graph's probabilities on the train partition
